sentences.text: The FIR is lodged by one Samir Shaikh.
He has stated  that his father had a shop at Dahisar (E) bearing shop No.18, C-  203, Green Mahel Park, Mira Road.
The informant had two  brothers Sikandar and Khalid.
The informant and his elder  brother were residing outside Mumbai because of their work.
They had executed power of attorney in the name of their  brother Khalid except for selling the shop.

On 30/08/2019,
 Khalid had given that shop No.18 to the present Applicant on  rent for three years.
That period was to get over on 30/04/2022.
Initially he paid the rent on time, but subsequently the Applicant  did not pay any rent.
It is alleged that the informant persistently  asked for his rent.
Therefore, on 28/10/2021 the Applicant had  sent Rs.1 lakhs as the rent for four months.
On 28/04/2022, the  informant went to that shop as the lease agreement was to get  over on 30/04/2022.
At that time, the Applicant told him that  he had purchased that shop from the informant's brother Khalid  for Rs.30 lakhs.
The Applicant filed one civil suit in that behalf.
The informant obtained the copies of that suit.

He came to know  that the Applicant was relying on the copy of an agreement for  sale, power of attorney, affidavit and possession letter executed Dinesh Shyamu Prajapati vs State Of Maharashtra on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/115100918/
